solutions.solution: import java.util.HashMap; import java.util.Map; public class MessageQueueConfigurator { public static Map configureMessageQueue(String exchangeName, String queueName, String routingKey) { Map config = new HashMap<>(); config.put("exchange", exchangeName); config.put("exchangeType", "topic"); config.put("queue", queueName); config.put("queueDurable", true); config.put("queueExclusive", false); config.put("queueAutoDelete", false); config.put("binding", routingKey); config.put("messageConverter", "JSON"); Map template = new HashMap<>(); template.put("connectionFactory", "simulated"); template.put("messageConverter", "JSON"); config.put("template", template); config.put("lastPublished", System.currentTimeMillis()); config.put("status", "READY"); return config; } public static Map publishMessage(Map config, String message) { if (config == null) { return null; } Object statusObj = config.get("status"); if ("READY".equals(statusObj)) { config.put("lastMessage", message); Object countObj = config.get("messageCount"); int count = 0; if (countObj instanceof Integer) { count = (Integer) countObj; } config.put("messageCount", count + 1); config.put("lastPublished", System.currentTimeMillis()); } return config; } }

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.HashMap;

public class UserAuthenticationService {

    public static class User {
        private String email;
        private String passwordHash;
        private String role;

        public User(String email, String passwordHash, String role) {
            this.email = email;
            this.passwordHash = passwordHash;
            this.role = role;
        }

        public String getEmail() {
            return email;
        }

        public String getPasswordHash() {
            return passwordHash;

        public String getRole() {
            return role;
        }
    }

    private Map<String, User> userDatabase;

    public UserAuthenticationService() {
        this.userDatabase = new HashMap<>();
    }
}

solutions.solution: import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger; public class ThreadManager { public ThreadStatistics manageThreads(int threadCount, long workDurationMs, long interruptAfterMs) { List threads = new ArrayList<>(); AtomicInteger completedTasks = new AtomicInteger(0); // Create and start worker threads for (int i = 0; i < threadCount; i++) { Thread t = new Thread(() -> { System.out.println(Thread.currentThread().getName() + " started"); try { Thread.sleep(workDurationMs); completedTasks.incrementAndGet(); // Increment on successful completion } catch (InterruptedException e) { // Thread was interrupted; do not increment } }, "Worker-" + i); threads.add(t); t.start(); } // Optional: interrupt all threads after a specified delay if (interruptAfterMs > 0) { new Thread(() -> { try { Thread.sleep(interruptAfterMs); } catch (InterruptedException e) { // ignore } for (Thread t : threads) { t.interrupt(); } }).start(); } // Wait for all threads to finish for (Thread t : threads) { try { t.join(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { // ignore } } // Return statistics with the correct count of completed tasks return new ThreadStatistics(threadCount, completedTasks.get(), 0); } } class ThreadStatistics { private final int totalThreads; private final int completedTasks; private final int interruptedTasks; public ThreadStatistics(int totalThreads, int completedTasks, int interruptedTasks) { this.totalThreads = totalThreads; this.completedTasks = completedTasks; this.interruptedTasks = interruptedTasks; } public int getTotalThreads() { return totalThreads; } public int getCompletedTasks() { return completedTasks; } public int getInterruptedTasks() { return interruptedTasks; } @Override public String toString() { return "ThreadStatistics{" + "totalThreads=" + totalThreads + ", completedTasks=" + completedTasks + ", interruptedTasks=" + interruptedTasks + '}'; } }
